scope: Fixed low-cost 2025/26 appearance experiment; inspected/reused outcomes, no promotion or point-gain claim
source: AIrsenal exact predeadline historical CSV prefixes: official FPL news/chance observations, not independent club news
target: Any minutes in the whole gameweek
features: Past-only last/five-match minutes/appearance, record count/days/position; chance normalized as covariate plus missing indicator; training-only TFIDF256 maxfeatures, min_df2, unigram/bigram
primary: candidate mean per-GW Brier: form_chance_text minus form; whole-GW block4/4000-replicate descriptive interval
other_metrics: all/candidate Brier, fixed reliability bins, false high-probability counts; report every arm, no winner tuning
rules: No same-GW history; all match features before exact-prefix publication minus3h; common sourced/known player universe, no hindsight eligibility or zero fill for missing targets
integration: Experimental only; no binaries saved, no multiplication of production points by p_play, no automatic overrides or weekly forecasts
